text:
Nora: Quick sync on the benchmark narrative — goal is one punchy chart + carousel of two supporting visuals. Target audience: engineers evaluating latency SLOs + product leads caring about cost. Ideas?

Devon: What about a performance-efficiency frontier chart: x-axis = p50 latency, y-axis = cost per 1k tokens, with a convex hull showing best-in-class points. Label common app buckets (chat widget, search, batch embed).

Priya: I like frontier. Can we annotate recommended routing thresholds on the hull? e.g., a vertical line at 250ms with a note: "recommended: route to low-latency model".

Ethan: Supporting visuals: 1) short waterfall showing where batching and KV cache reduce cost per token; 2) small Sankey showing traffic split when you enable latency-based routing (percent to low-latency vs cost-optimized).

Sam: Messaging options for header: "Latency guarantees without the price tag" or "Route smarter: save cost, keep fast responses". Which leans PLG?

Priya: Second is more pragmatic/PLG. First reads enterprise. We should A/B both on landing.

Nora: Agree. Also need a simple one-line positioning blurb for the deck: "Redwood lets you pick the right model at the right time1 reducing inference spend while meeting latency SLOs." Thoughts?

Devon: Short technical callout block for the blog: "How we measured: identical prompt set, 2k warmup tokens, 10k sample tokens, continuous batching disabled for latency points, enabled for cost points." Put raw CSV link in appendix.

bench-bot: New benchmark artifact available: s3://redwood-bench/2026-11-14_09/frontier-report.html; run_id=2026-11-14_09

Ethan: Numbers preview (p50 / cost_norm):
```
fast-model: 95ms / 1.15
balanced-quant: 240ms / 0.52
cheap-8bit: 420ms / 0.28
```
Use these for mockups, will update with final CSV.

Priya: For the Sankey, suggest showing hypothetical 10k reqs: start all -> 70% to fast-model (p50 <250ms), 30% to cheap-8bit; annotate average cost delta and p95 tail handling.

Sam: Landing page form: add radio for "I care about latency" vs "I care about cost" so we can route leads to self-serve vs sales. Also add an optional question: "Interested in Dedicated capacity?"

Nora: Webinar plan: 20min walkthrough (show hero frontier + Sankey + batching waterfall), 15min live Q&A, capture attendee SLO priorities in a quick poll. Timing: week of Nov 22?

Devon: Can we get a small code snippet for the blog showing runtime routing decision? Like:
```
if latency_target < 250:
  route_to('fast-model')
else:
  route_to('cheap-8bit')
```
Keep it pseudocode.

Priya: We should surface the cost math: show example savings for a hypothetical app (chat at 100k monthly reqs) with and without routing. Quick calc in slide notes.

Ethan: I'll prepare the hero SVG (1200x600) and two PNGs for deck. Mock numbers plugged in.

Sam: Drafted two headline variants in the content doc and added the lead routing form fields in Notion (link in doc).

Nora: Action items: Devon to create frontier figure mock, Ethan to export images, Priya to draft copy and savings calc, Sam to wire landing form. Review at 11am tomorrow.

Devon: Mock pushed: https://drive.redwood.com/bench/frontier-mock.svg (check annotations).

bench-bot: Reminder: next automated run scheduled 2026-11-21_09.

Nora: Nice, thanks all. Keep visuals minimal and annotation-forward 1 we want one clear takeaway on the hero. See you at 11. :sparkles:
